investigation_notes.Description: The alert shows an unusually large SharePoint download activity (1,450 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 15) by Tanel.Lepp@globalcorp.ee targeting restricted HR/legal/payroll paths. The user is listed as a Software Engineer in Engineering and the activity originated from IP 113.161.12.88 geolocated to Đồng Hới, Vietnam; the event time converts to 2026-02-01 06:58:45 +07:00, which is outside normal business hours and follows a recent login-location anomaly (SOC-14215) for the same user and IP. Given the very high volume relative to baseline, the clear role-to-data mismatch, and the anomalous geolocation outside Europe with a recent related alert, this activity is assessed as High Priority.
